verdict.rationale: Isaac documents generating synthetic data, capturing sensor data and teleoperation demonstrations, and converting demonstrations for GR00T post-training. None of the evidence describes an API or SQL interface for querying and exporting collected robot data for offline analysis. Data generation and conversion are adjacent capabilities, not a query/export interface, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query and export collected robot data through an API or SQL for offline analysis
